title: Hand sketches of trail path near Las Vegas: "Side View" and "View from Above" (Oct 1947)
description: Typed account of an October 8 or 9, 1947 sighting on the NW outskirts of Las Vegas, Nevada, of what resembled a sky-writing trail, followed by two hand-drawn diagrams. The "Side View" shows a climbing trail at a "40° angle" toward "Mt Charleston" about "5 miles" from "my position"; the "View from Above" shows a looping turn path with arrows, "first sighted" point, "Mt Charleston", a compass rose, and "My Position".
